page.overview:
Who is Aron Peacebringer's daughter?

Aron Peacebringer, Warlord of the Calian Confederacy on Shiva IV, and his wife Alisande had a daughter at some point before 3 ABY. The girl died in infancy after falling ill with a disease that Peacebringer also contracted, although her father ultimately survived.
